_about: The components a TDD source can use: what each is for, its markdown, its attributes, where it may sit, what it compiles to (the content.json node type) and what draws it. One entry per authoring construct; `tdd components` prints this file and `tdd components --gallery <dir>` writes a packet that renders every example. cli/test/components keeps it true: every example compiles to the node it names, and every node type the renderer draws (app/src/types.ts NODE_TYPES) is listed here.

internal.placeholder: what the compiler leaves where a diagram, an image or the PR cards are missing (it also warns)
internal.box: an unknown ::: kind: the compiler warns and keeps the blocks in a plain div

components.name: section
components.what: A numbered section. The house template has six, always in the same order.

attrs.#id: the section's anchor; default: a slug of the title
attrs.lead: no: the first paragraph is not styled as the lead

components.renders: App.tsx Section: section > h2 (.sec-no, .chip); the contents rail lists it
notes: The first paragraph is the lead (the finding, not the topic) unless lead: no.
components.example:
## Retries move out of the request {#retries; chip: First pass}

A failed delivery is retried by a worker, not by the request that failed.

components.name: subsection
components.what: A heading inside a section. A level-3 heading gets an anchor and a line in the contents rail.

attrs.#id: the anchor; default for ###: a slug of the title
attrs.nav: no keeps it out of the rail; any other text is the rail label

components.example:
### What the worker reads {#worker-reads}

The worker reads `webhook_deliveries` and nothing else.

components.name: paragraph
components.what: Running text. A trailing {…} sets its class or anchor.

attrs.#id: an anchor other blocks can reference

components.example: Counts are from the read replica on 2026-01-12. {small; muted}

components.name: chip
components.what: A status chip inside any text.

attrs.tone: new, good, done, built, open, draft, proposed, rec, held, blocked, danger, violet, brand, ruled, or plain for no colour

components.where: inside any paragraph, heading, cell or list item
components.example: The retry worker [chip:new new] replaces the inline retry [chip:held removed].

components.name: reference-token
components.what: Tokens such as `D7`, `Q1`, `R2`, `PR 3` or `F3.2`, and glossary terms, link to their definition on the page; hover shows a card, click opens a panel.
components.where: any text outside code, links and headings
notes: A token links only when the page defines it: a decision, a table row whose first cell is the token, a PR card, a glossary term, or a refs family in meta.json.
The linter fails a token with no definition (REFS).
components.example:
| # | Requirement | Status |
|---|---|---|
| R1 | A delivery is retried at most five times | Planned |

The cap in R1 comes from the provider's own limit.

components.name: citation
components.what: A path:line in backticks is a citation; with repo_url and sha in meta.json it links to that line at that commit.
notes: Path aliases (meta.json path_aliases) shorten long prefixes, for example `API/send.ts:88`.
components.example: The request retries inline today (`src/webhooks/send.ts:88-120`).

components.name: list
components.what: Bullets, numbers or a checklist. A leading [new], [changed], [done], [open] or [held] tags an item.
components.syntax:
- item
1. item
- [x] done item
- [new] tagged item
components.renders: Blocks.tsx List: ul or ol, li (.new, .changed, .done, .todo)
notes: A list is a checklist only when every item has a [ ] or [x] box.
components.example:
- [new] The worker claims a row with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`.
- The request path no longer sleeps.
  - It returns as soon as the row is written.

components.name: steps
components.what: A numbered flow with step numbers drawn as badges.
components.where: anywhere; usually inside a col of a Step by step fold
components.example:
::: steps
1. The request writes the delivery row.
2. [new] The worker picks it up within a second.
3. [new] After five failures the row is parked.
:::

components.name: table
components.what: A table. A first cell that is a reference token (`R1`, `F2`) makes the row an anchor; a column named Status or State turns its words into chips; all-number columns are right-aligned.
components.renders: Blocks.tsx Table: div.tbl > table (td.num, td.tok, tr[id])
components.example:
| # | Requirement | Status | How the design meets it |
|---|---|---|---|
| R1 | A delivery is retried at most five times | Planned | The worker's attempt counter |
| R2 | A parked delivery can be replayed | Open | Waiting on the owner's answer |

components.name: code
components.what: A fenced code block. sql fences get keyword and comment marks; the agents lane extracts every block.
notes: A ::: line inside a fence is still read as a container: indent it by a space when quoting template syntax.

components.name: callout
components.what: A tinted aside.

attrs.title word: note (default), warn, good, danger, violet or blue

components.example:
::: callout warn
**Rollback:** turn the flag off; rows already written stay and are ignored.
:::

components.name: quote
components.what: A markdown quote, for an owner's words.
components.example: > Retry in the background, never in the request.

components.name: diagram
components.what: A figure from diagrams/<key>.svg (or .png). The legend and reading lines that follow belong to it; diagrams/<key>.hotspots.json adds hover cards and schema-table cards over its boxes.
components.syntax:
[diagram: key · Figure title {fit; #id; alt: text}]
[legend: label = tone | label = tone]
[reading: one sentence on where to start]

attrs.fit: scale the figure to the column (a button toggles actual size)
attrs.#id: the anchor, also listed in the rail; default fig-<key>
attrs.nav: no keeps it out of the rail

components.renders: Diagram.tsx: figure.diagram (.bar, .stage, a.hs hotspots, TableNode cards, figcaption .key .reading)
notes: Legend tones: new, changed, app, existing, engine, data, alert, violet, dashed, proposed.
A missing file renders a placeholder line and the compiler warns.
components.example:
[diagram: redesign · Redesign: retries move to a worker {fit; #fig-retries}]
[legend: new or changed = new | the app = app | proposed = proposed]
[reading: Start at the request on the left; green boxes are new.]

components.name: legend
components.what: A legend on its own, away from a diagram.
components.example:
Colours on every diagram on this page:

[legend: new or changed = new | the app = app | needs a data source = data]

components.name: shot
components.what: A mock or a still, with the quoted text as its caption. Click opens the lightbox.
notes: Mocks are built from the project's real components (references/mock-conventions.md).
components.example: ![The deliveries list with a parked row](mockups/moment-a-1.svg "Parked: the fifth attempt failed")

components.name: shots
components.what: Two or more images in one paragraph: the stills side by side.
components.example: ![Before the retry](mockups/moment-a-1.svg "Queued") ![After the retry](mockups/moment-a-2.svg "Delivered")

components.name: cards
components.what: A row of cards; each #### heading starts one.

attrs.stat: stat cards: the heading is the number

notes: No comment before the first #### of a cards block.
components.example:
::: cards {four}
#### What is new
One table and one worker.

#### What doesn't change
The payload and its signature.

#### The one deliberate change
The request no longer waits for the retry.

#### Who it reaches first
The 40 merchants on the beta flag.
:::

components.name: persona
components.what: One person at one moment: text first, then the mocked states, then a today fold.
components.syntax:
::: persona Role · Moment {chip: changed; tone: new; #id; shots: cols3}
text {small}

![alt](mockups/a.png "Caption")

:::: today What it does today
![alt](mockups/today.png "Today")
::::
:::

attrs.chip: the chip text beside the title
attrs.shots: auto (default), cols3, cols2, or one size for every shot: phone, mid, wide, col
attrs.nav: no keeps it out of the rail

components.where: in a section, or inside ::: duo
components.example:
::: persona Support agent · A delivery failed five times {chip: changed; #fe-parked; shots: cols3}
The agent sees the parked row and why it stopped. {small}

![The parked row](mockups/moment-a-1.svg "Parked")

![The attempt log](mockups/moment-a-2.svg "Five attempts")

![Replay confirmed](mockups/moment-a-3.svg "Replayed")

:::: today No parked state: the row just says failed
![Today's list](mockups/today-moment-a.svg "Today: failed, with no reason")
::::
:::

components.name: today
components.what: The screen as it is now, folded under a persona box for comparison.

attrs.label: the fold's label; default: Today, for comparison

components.name: duo
components.what: Two persona boxes side by side.
components.syntax:
::: duo
:::: persona A · Moment {chip: changed}
text
::::
:::: persona B · Moment {chip: new}
text
::::
:::

components.name: fold
components.what: A reference block that is closed until opened. The title's text after · is its one-line summary.

attrs.#id: the anchor; an explicit id also lists the fold in the rail
attrs.nav: no keeps it out of the rail

notes: A section with three or more folds gets Expand all and Collapse all.
components.example:
::: fold Rollout · Flag, order of steps, rollback {#rollout}
- Dark behind `webhook_retry_worker`.
- On for the beta merchants, then everyone.
:::

components.name: group
components.what: A titled set of folds.
components.example:
::: group Engineering reference · The SQL and the PR order
:::: fold Schema · One new table {#schema-sql}
`webhook_deliveries` holds one row per delivery.
::::
:::

components.name: decisions
components.what: The grid that holds decision cards.
components.example:
::: decisions
:::: decision D1 · Retries run in a worker {status: Owner, 2026-01-12}
"Retry in the background, never in the request." The request path returns after one attempt.
::::
:::

components.name: decision
components.what: One decision or open question. A Q-number is open; a D-number is the owner's answer, in their words, with the date.

attrs.status: who and when, or why it is open; a date makes it done, Open/Provisional/Proposed/Waiting keeps it open, Held/Blocked/Rejected holds it
attrs.state: done, open or held, to override what the status implies
attrs.#id: the anchor; default: the token (d1, q1)
attrs.nav: no keeps it out of the rail

components.example:
::: decisions
:::: decision Q1 · Who may replay a parked delivery? {status: Open · waiting on the owner; wide}
Support can see parked rows today but cannot act on them.

::::: options
#### A · Support and the merchant {rec}
Both get the button; every replay is logged with who pressed it.
#### B · Support only
The merchant has to ask.
:::::
::::
:::

components.name: options
components.what: The options of an open question; each #### heading starts one and {rec} marks the recommendation.
components.syntax:
::::: options
#### A · Option {rec}
text
#### B · Option
text
:::::
notes: No comment inside an options block.
components.example:
::: decisions
:::: decision Q2 · How long is a parked delivery kept? {status: Open · waiting on the owner}
::::: options
#### A · 30 days {rec}
Matches the log retention.
#### B · Forever
The table grows without bound.
:::::
::::
:::

components.name: cols
components.what: Two columns; each ::: col is one.
notes: No comment directly inside a cols block.
components.example:
::: cols
:::: col
### Request

Writes the row and returns.
::::

:::: col
### Worker

Claims the row and sends.
::::
:::

components.name: glossary
components.what: Terms and definitions. Every later use of a term on the page links to its entry.
components.example:
::: glossary
- **DLQ** — dead-letter queue: where a delivery waits after its last attempt
:::

components.name: prs
components.what: The PR cards: one card per prs/pr-NN.md, grouped by milestone.
components.where: usually inside the PR order fold
notes: Each prs/pr-NN.md has front matter (milestone, title, change, rollback) and a body; see vendor/system-design/templates/pr-cards.md.
With no prs/ folder the compiler leaves a placeholder line and warns.
components.example:
Sized by dependency, not by date. {small; muted}

<!-- PR-CARDS -->

components.name: rule
components.what: A horizontal rule.
components.example:
Above the rule.
